plugins._doc: The organization's own extensions, loaded by name (alib.plugins): modules under assistant/scripts the engine asks for hooks by attribute - executor ticket kinds beyond the engine's (KIND_LANES, REQUIRED_KEYS, validate, EXECUTORS, result_line, after_done), the standing-texts resolver (who a text goes to, the per-event reminders), extra sentinel findings and sensor commands, the agent turn's extra MCP servers. A name that is not here is skipped, so the engine runs the same with none; a sage-core export never carries them (core_sync.json -> niche_paths).

operator._sensors_doc: the organization's own sensor scripts (assistant/scripts), run by operator_cron.ps1 after the engine's; a missing one is skipped

texts.checkin_body:
Hi {first}! {wedding_date} is two weeks away, so exciting! Let's set up a quick check-in call to go over your timeline and details. You can pick the time that works best for you here: {scheduler_link}

owner1

voice._doc: The voice gate (assistant/agent/voice.py, the owner 2026-10-27: 'interacting with Sage should feel exactly like interacting with a real person'). Every line code posts to Chat passes it: system talk (status, raw output, chase lines, scorecards, review summaries, slipped builds, unconfirmed outcomes) never reaches Chat - its Mission Control note is already written; the rest is said the way a person says it (names, no ids). system_lines true lets system talk through again; dedupe_minutes: the same words to the same place within this window post once.

doer._doc: assistant/doer: one on-demand browser agent per agent_run ticket. offscreen=false shows the window while it works. notes_per_job_max = how many of the turn's milestone notes (report.py note) reach the job's chat thread; continues_max = how many times a run that ended on max_turns or its time limit is continued from its notes (doer.carry_on) before the owner hears it stopped.

personal_exceptions._doc: Ruling 13 (2026-10-15): personal texts stay out of the card stream EXCEPT a time-related one (a date/time and a plan) or a money-tied one (an amount, pay/owe/venmo), which may get a draft card marked payload.exception. The owners' own numbers never come through. Words: assistant/mining.json -> personal_text_exception.

brief._doc: Sage's morning brief (assistant/prompts/brief.md). connections: the connection ids (assistant/connections.json) the brief names in its one CONNECTIONS sentence when they are not configured or dead, with the chat phrase or Setup-page button that fixes each (plan 2026-10-18 section 2: so they stop surfacing as mid-task failures). Order = order in the sentence. Working connections are never mentioned. Remove an id here once the owner decides a connection is not wanted.

cards._doc: Approval delivery (the owner 2026-10-20: 'I only want a drop down long list of cards once a week ... I need an approval to text new prospects ASAP when a new one comes in with a phone number ... normal approvals will be singular cards'). delivery 'weekly': every card is HELD (open on Mission Control the moment it is posted, nothing in Chat) until the weekly digest - ONE collapsible Chat message holding every held card - and a decision there is final: no re-ask, no follow-up card, unless the action was not confirmed done (then the card comes back). Only URGENT cards reach Chat the minute they are posted, each on its own, never stacked: the new-lead text (client_texts lead_intro), a card posted with "urgent": true, a header starting with one of urgent_header_prefixes, a card an owner asked for in a chat thread. delivery 'now' = the old behaviour (every card to Chat at once, stacked). digest_day (mon..sun) + digest_hour (local) is the slot; max_per_message splits an oversized digest into numbered parts; a digest card still unanswered at the next digest rides along carry_over_weeks more times, then expires; say_empty posts one line when nothing waits. Env ASSISTANT_CARDS_DELIVERY overrides delivery (tests). system_to_chat (2026-10-27, voice.py): a card about the machinery (a sentinel finding, an outcome not confirmed, a connection down, a channel paused, a failed self-test) is NEVER urgent and never in the digest whatever its poster said - Mission Control only, where the reflex works it (reflex.d_system_cards) and says one plain line only when an owner has to act. true = the old behaviour.

deadman._doc: The watcher of the watchers (assistant/scripts/deadman.py, its own scheduled task every 30 min, WP2 2026-10-24). email_fallback: when the chat path is down too, one email to the owner's own address through email_send.py (inside the household, inside the gate).

reminders._doc: assistant/agent/event_reminders.py (2026-10-25, the owner after Tony's party: 'You should have given me reminders about it'): one line in the owner's chat events_lead_min minutes before every timed event on a connected owner calendar (client meetings are meeting_reminder.py's). events:false switches it off. Events Sage adds itself also get a once-reminder (actions._event_reminder).
